signals.title: sudosubin/agents.nix
signals.content: Nixpkgs overlay for AI agent skills from skills.sh and skillsdirectory.com
signals.score_reason: high-value open-source ecosystem signal; agentic AI relevance. Final score: 72. Freshness: source age 0d.
signals.brief_en:
Title: sudosubin/agents.nix
Source: Nixpkgs overlay that aggregates AI agent skill definitions from the public repositories skills.sh and skillsdirectory.com. The overlay provides a declarative, reproducible way to import, version‑pin, and configure these skill modules within Nix environments. It enables rapid composition of agent capabilities while preserving reproducibility and traceability of the underlying skill sources. Current coverage includes natural‑language processing, data extraction, and tool‑use modules; however, the completeness of the skill set is limited to what is publicly available on the two source sites and may evolve over time.
signals.brief_ar:
العنوان: sudosubin/agents.nix
المصدر: طبقة Nixpkgs تجمع تعريفات مهارات وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي من المستودعات العامة skills.sh و skillsdirectory.com. توفّر الطبقة طريقة إعلانية وقابلة لإعادة الإنتاج لاستيراد وتثبيت وإعداد هذه الوحدات داخل بيئات Nix. تمكّن من تركيب قدرات الوكيل بسرعة مع الحفاظ على قابلية التتبع وإعادة البناء لمصادر المهارات. تشمل التغطية الحالية وحدات معالجة اللغة الطبيعية، استخراج البيانات، واستخدام الأدوات؛ إلا أن شمولية مجموعة المهارات مقصورة على ما هو متاح علنًا في الموقعين وقد تتغير مع مرور الوقت.

signals.brief_en:
Title: kirtipandey2/Research-Paper-Agent

An AI-driven agent designed to locate, analyze, and summarize scholarly articles. It leverages open‑source search tools and natural‑language processing to extract key findings, methodologies, and citations. The system provides concise, citation‑rich summaries for rapid assessment, while flagging gaps or uncertainties in the source material. Intended for researchers and analysts needing efficient literature reviews.

signals.content: MIT Student Documents Tech Worker Protests https://t.co/vd783jghgb MIT PhD student JS Tan co authored a book about tech worker protests and employer backlash. Against Tech Oligarchy was published by Haymarket Books in September 2026. Tan and Clarissa Redwine document tech worker organizing in Silicon Valley over the past decade. Tan joined the tech industry in 2015 after graduating from Brown University and Rhode Island School of Design. In 2017 Donald Trump signed an order suspending entry for nationals from seven mostly Muslim countries for 90 days. In 2018 nearly 4000 Google employees signed a letter opposing Project Maven. Earlier in 2026 more than 600 Google employees signed a letter opposing classified AI work with the Pentagon. Tan enrolled at MIT in 2020 and is now a doctoral student in urban studies and planning.
